generated_by: measured against qwen3:8b during Phase B, task B7
question: Does telling a mandate not to invent citations stop it inventing citations?

experiment.setup: One CFO turn, Decide stage, no documents in the room, qwen3:8b, think=false, 180 tokens.
experiment.instruction_added: The room has been given no documents for this decision. If your argument needs evidence you do not have, say what evidence would settle it rather than supplying a source. Do not invent a report, a statistic or a citation.

what_the_instruction_DID_fix.before: An unconditional mention of <untrusted_content> in the system prompt produced a turn arguing that 'the untrusted_content cites a 2022 study that overstates regional retail growth' — when no documents existed. Naming a container was enough for the model to invent something to put in it.
what_the_instruction_DID_fix.after: The phantom fenced document no longer appears. The fence instruction is now emitted only when there is actually fenced material.
what_the_instruction_DID_fix.lesson: An instruction about evidence that does not exist is not a safeguard; it is a prompt for a hallucination.

what_the_instruction_DID_NOT_fix.turn_produced: We should pilot in the Greenlam plant first. The Dubai hypermarket is a high-cost, low-margin environment with a 22% higher operational expense ratio than the Greenlam average (Q3 2024 report).
fabrications: 22% higher operational expense ratio — no source
18% more in upfront investment — no source
what_the_instruction_DID_NOT_fix.note: The same turn also correctly volunteered its declared blind spot: 'My blind spot is anchoring on the first number.' The mandate is being followed. The fabrication is not disobedience.

auditor_result.verdict: Both fabrications caught by the mechanical rules in the same turn the instruction failed to prevent them.

conclusion: This is the clearest evidence in the project for why COUNSEL's guarantees are mechanical rather than prompted. A mandate told to cite will cite; a mandate told NOT to invent will still invent, in the exact house style its evidence standards ask for. Prompting shapes what an agent tries to do. Only a check that opens the citation knows whether it resolves.
